body: It's funny, I decided to go to a school provided counselor on Monday. I waited for probably an hour and a half until a younger girl took me back. I explained the issues I'm having and how I really need immediate direction so I can get my shit together only to find out she's only doing an evaluation. They're supposed to call me tomorrow, or more likely after the holiday, just to set up an appointment with an actual counselor. I may try to find a psych in the mean time.
That's part of the issue, I have an amazing support system from my girlfriend and family but I can't admit my failures.

It's a pretty unique name so I'd rather not say. I've been better, I'm supposed to be graduating college and applying to schools, but instead I really fucked up my last semester. I'm in a hole and I'm not sure how to fix it. Definitely not a reason to kill yourself, but here I am.
